notes: Faculty were not unionised (version note on 2018_00); the governing documents are UA HR policies and the University Handbook for Appointed Personnel (UHAP).

2018_07 (Faculty Affairs page) is a summary of UHAP 3.3; it restates the clock-delay grounds and adds nothing that changes the coding. 2018_00, 2018_03 and 2018_09 FAQ/Related Information sections are stated to be not part of official policy; the FMLA dual-employee 12-week limit and the 30-day notice are taken from the FMLA FAQ and match the statute.
2018_05 Medical Leave carries no version or revision date; capture 2018-07-01 (after the reference date), accepted as in force; c10 flagged version_uncertain.
UHAP 3.3.01.A.2 professional-reason clock delays (adverse professional circumstances; prestigious external commitments) are not components: a parent could not use them for a birth.
Short-term disability (c8) is employee-purchased (R1d's own Arizona example) and states 'six to eight weeks' after a birth with no pay level, so V1 fails and it is a generic plan, employee_paid.

Birth-parent chain: Parental Leave 6 (paid, full) with FMLA 12 alongside from the start (concurrent_with) → own sick time (and vacation) beyond the six weeks, within FMLA → unpaid Medical Leave for pregnancy and recuperation up to 6 months after sick leave is exhausted (discretionary); STD insurance (employee-paid) and donated hours lie within FMLA; temporary alternative duty assignment (other) also available.

Non-birth-parent chain: Parental Leave 6 (paid, full) with FMLA 12 alongside from the start → own sick time (family illness) or vacation beyond the six weeks, within FMLA → general unpaid leave of absence after FMLA (general_purpose, not counted).

No calendar term length stated; calendar omitted. No combined leave limit or all-sources paid cap stated (HR-302 says Parental Leave 'is not designed to extend' FMLA: coded as concurrency, not a leave_limits entry).
